title: High Times
subtitle: Special Collector's Edition, August 2019

description.main: The August 2019 special collector's edition of High Times, No. 523, carries a Richard Prince cover drawing and launches his Katz + Dogg cannabis brand. Staple-bound, 134 pages, offset in colour, edition of 30,000. The magazine issue, not the 2018 Gagosian book.
description.extended:
The August 2019 special collector's edition of High Times, No. 523, carries a Richard Prince cover drawing and launches his Katz + Dogg cannabis brand.

High Times is the monthly Tom Forçade founded in New York in 1974 as a one-off parody of Playboy with marijuana in place of sex. This number runs 134 staple-bound pages, offset in colour, in an edition of 30,000. A grinning green-haired figure in marker, drawn in the manner of the Hippie Drawings and signed and dated 2019, fills the cover. The headline reads Katz and Dogg Special Edition Launch by Richard Prince. The other cover lines are the usual fare, Dead and Company on tour, New England grows, CBD tinctures. It was Prince's second High Times cover in a year, after the January 2019 issue ran one of his figures under the headline High Art.

The High Times paintings grew out of the Hippie Drawings of 1998 to 1999. From 2017 Prince had the drawings reproduced in inkjet, collaged them onto canvas and worked over them in oil stick, acrylic and charcoal. Gagosian showed them at West 21st Street, New York, in late 2018 and in San Francisco from May 30 to August 23, 2019. Katz + Dogg, made with 710 Labs and named for Prince's pseudonyms Joan Katz and John Dogg, launched on the San Francisco opening night. The Gagosian book of the paintings is held separately here.
description.artist_bio: Richard Prince (b. 1949, Panama Canal Zone) has worked since the late 1970s by rephotographing and reworking images, texts and personas from American mass media and subcultures, from the Marlboro cowboys to the Jokes, Nurses and Instagram portraits. The Hippie Drawings and High Times paintings mark his turn to invented figuration; Katz + Dogg (2019) extended the series into a cannabis brand and merchandise. He is represented by Gagosian.
description.exhibition_context: Richard Prince: High Times, Gagosian West 21st Street, New York, November 1 to December 19, 2018; Richard Prince: High Times, Gagosian San Francisco, May 30 to August 23, 2019. The magazine issue coincides with the San Francisco show and the Katz + Dogg launch.

notes: Magazine issue; the Gagosian 2018 book is id 896. High Times No. 523, August 2019, Special Collector's Edition (Katz and Dogg special edition launch by Richard Prince; cover drawing signed and dated 2019). Printed Matter lists it as the Trippy issue, but the Trippy issue was September 2016 (No. 488); the cover of this copy says Special Collector's Edition. Publisher per Printed Matter: Trans High Corporation (Hightimes Holding Corp. owned the title from 2017). Editor-in-chief credit (Dan Skye) from Wikipedia, not from the masthead. No ISBN. Acquired from Printed Matter, New York: https://www.printedmatter.org/catalog/71956 (stock 228838 C). Not signed.
